steps.title: Analyze and Plan Modern Calculator Requirements
steps.description: Design an interactive, feature-rich calculator with custom dark/light theme capabilities and expression parsing.

steps.title: Create application metadata configuration in app-meta.json
steps.description: Define app_name and package_name variables specifically for Modern Calculator.

steps.title: Configure top-level build.gradle dependencies
steps.description: Establish target SDK 34, Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2, and repository options.

steps.title: Configure settings.gradle with target project structure
steps.description: Include the app module within the root gradle compilation tree.

steps.title: Configure app/build.gradle with build settings
steps.description: Configure the core app environment including target and min SDK, and ensure Java 8 compliance.

steps.title: Create AndroidManifest.xml and verify namespace
steps.description: Validate system attributes using standard namespaces and point launch intents directly to MainActivity.

steps.title: Design layout xml with a beautiful, responsive key layout
steps.description: Construct activity_main.xml layout with structured vertical displays, operation pads, and theme toggling controllers.

steps.title: Implement core UI elements and layout binding
steps.description: Write standard native bindings inside MainActivity.java referencing all digit pads, display monitors, and control buttons.

steps.title: Develop mathematical expression parser engine
steps.description: Write a lightweight, robust custom math evaluator in pure Java 8 to compute multi-operator formulas.

steps.title: Implement input processing logic
steps.description: Build state management mechanisms to handle numeric inputs, operations, parentheses, backspacing, and input clear options.

steps.title: Implement interactive light/dark UI themes
steps.description: Establish dynamic theme changes that alter layout backgrounds, display colors, and button styling programmatically.

steps.title: Implement mathematical history memory log
steps.description: Add continuous calculation memory tracking and present logs directly to display screens.

steps.title: Apply Java 8 compiler validation checks
steps.description: Ensure no lambdas, streams, or un-supported components compile within the code structure.

steps.title: Verify final XML syntax and asset references
steps.description: Double check the validity of Android system resources, icon settings, and attribute layouts.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile the complete package using Gradle 8.5 assemble commands to deliver the final functional APK.
